title: Slow English Podcast #363: 20 Easy Facts About Belize

sentences.text: Hello everyone, my name is Emily, welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
I am very happy you are here today.
Today we will learn about a beautiful country in Central America.
The country is Belize.
I will speak slowly and use easy English.
Let's begin.
Fact one, Belize is in Central America.
Belize is a small country in Central America.
It is between Mexico and Guatemala.
The Caribbean Sea is to the east.
Belize has beautiful beaches, forests and islands.
Many tourists visit every year.
Fact two, the capital city is Belmo Pen.
Belmo Pen is the capital of Belize.
It is a small and peaceful city.
Many government buildings are there.
People work, study and live in the city.
It is an important place in the country.
Fact three, English is the official language.
Belize is the only country in Central America with English
as its official language.
Children learn English at school.
Many people also speak Spanish and Belize in Creole.
Some people speak Maya languages and Garafuna.
Belize is a multilingual country.
Fact four, Belize has the Belize Barrier Reef.
The Belize Barrier Reef is very famous.
It is one of the largest coral reefs in the world.
Many colorful fish live there.
People enjoy snorkeling and diving.
The reef is beautiful and important for nature.
Fact five, Belize has many islands.
The islands are called Kais.
Many people visit Ambergris Kai and Kai Kalkar.
The water is clear and blue.
Visitors enjoy swimming and relaxing.
The islands are very popular.
Fact six, nature is everywhere.
Belize has many rainforests.
There are rivers, caves and waterfalls.
Many wild animals live in the forests.
People enjoy hiking and exploring nature.
The country protects many natural areas.
Fact seven, Belize has amazing wildlife.
People can see jaguars, monkeys and toucans.
Many colorful birds live in Belize.
Sea turtles also live near the coast.
Nature lovers enjoy visiting the country.
Wildlife is an important part of Belize.
Fact eight, family is very important.
Families enjoy spending time together.
People often visit relatives.
Family meals are special.
Children respect their parents and grandparents.
Strong family values are important.
Fact nine, Belize has ancient Maya ruins.
Many Maya cities were built long ago.
Visitors enjoy exploring these historic places.
The ruins tell the story of ancient civilizations.
Some ruins are deep in the jungle.
History is everywhere.
Fact 10, Belize has warm weather.
The weather is warm for most of the year.
There is a rainy season and a dry season.
Many people enjoy the sunshine.
Palm trees grow across the country.
The climate is great for outdoor activities.
Fact 11, fishing is popular.
Many people fish in the sea.
Fresh seafood is common.
People catch fish, lobster, and shrimp.
Fishing is important for many families.
Visitors also enjoy fishing trips.
12, Belize has beautiful national parks.
There are many protected parks.
People enjoy walking and bird watching.
The forests are peaceful.
Many animals live safely there.
Nature is carefully protected.
Fact 13, music is important.
People enjoy garafuna music.
Drums are often used.
Music is part of festivals and celebrations.
People love to dance.
Music brings communities together.
Fact 14, football is popular.
Many children play football.
People also enjoy basketball and volleyball.
Sports are fun for families and friends.
Schools organize sports activities.
Sports help people stay healthy.
Fact 15, Belize has colorful flowers.
Many tropical flowers grow in Belize.
The forests are full of plants.
Butterflies visit the flowers.
Nature looks beautiful all year.
Visitors enjoy taking photos.
Fact 16, festivals are exciting.
People celebrate many cultural festivals.
Music, dancing, and food are part of the celebrations.
Families enjoy spending time together.
Visitors are welcome to join.
Festivals are full of joy.
Fact 17, the people are friendly.
Visitors often say the people are kind and welcoming.
People enjoy helping tourists.
Hospitality is important.
Guests feel comfortable.
Many travelers want to visit again.
Fact 18, traveling is easy.
People travel by car, bus, and boat.
Small airplanes also connect some islands.
Roads connect many towns.
Boats are important for island travel.
Visitors can explore many beautiful places.
Fact 19, tourism is important.
Millions of visitors come to enjoy nature and the sea.
They visit beaches, reefs, forests, and Maya ruins.
Many people also enjoy local food and culture.
Tourism helps the country's economy.
Belize is a wonderful place to visit.
Fact 20, Belize is a country full of nature, history,
and friendly people.
It has beautiful beaches, amazing reefs, tropical forests,
ancient Maya ruins, colorful wildlife, and rich culture.
Visitors can enjoy adventure, history, and delicious local food.
Belize is small, but it offers unforgettable experiences.
I hope you learned something new today.
Keep listening, keep practicing, and keep enjoying English.
My name is Emily.
